+def _start_reactor() -> None:

+def _ensure_reactor_running() -> None:
+    global _REACTOR_THREAD
+    if reactor.running:

+    if _REACTOR_THREAD is None:
+        _REACTOR_THREAD = threading.Thread(target=_start_reactor, daemon=True)

+class _CaseInsensitiveHeaders:
+    def __init__(self, raw_headers):
+        self._headers = {}
+        for name, values in raw_headers.getAllRawHeaders():
+            key = name.decode('latin-1').lower()
+            self._headers[key] = ', '.join(
+                value.decode('latin-1') for value in values
+            )
+
+    def __getitem__(self, key):
+        return self._headers[key.lower()]
+
+    def get(self, key, default=None):
+        return self._headers.get(key.lower(), default)

+
+class _TreqResponse:
+    def __init__(self, response, content: bytes):
+        self.code = response.code
+        self.headers = _CaseInsensitiveHeaders(response.headers)
+        self.content = content
+        self.text = content.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
+
+    def raise_for_status(self):
+        if self.code >= 400:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'HTTP {self.code}')
+
+
+class _TreqSession:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._agents = {}
+
+    def _proxy_uri(self, proxies):
+        if not proxies:
+            return None
+        return proxies.get('https') or proxies.get('http')
+
+    def _agent(self, verify_ssl, proxies):
+        key = (verify_ssl, self._proxy_uri(proxies))
+        if key not in self._agents:
+            pool = HTTPConnectionPool(reactor, persistent=True)
+            proxy_uri = key[1]
+            if proxy_uri:
+                self._agents[key] = ProxyAgent(
+                    reactor,
+                    proxy_uri.encode('utf-8'),
+                    pool=pool,
+                )
+            else:
+                context_factory = (
+                    BrowserLikePolicyForHTTPS()
+                    if verify_ssl else WebClientContextFactory()
+                )
+                self._agents[key] = Agent(
+                    reactor,
+                    contextFactory=context_factory,
+                    pool=pool,
+                )
+        return self._agents[key]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_headers(headers):
+        if not headers:
+            return None
+
+        raw_headers = Headers()
+        for name, value in headers.items():
+            values = value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else [value]
+            raw_headers.setRawHeaders(
+                name.encode('ascii'),
+                [str(item).encode('utf-8') for item in values],
+            )
+        return raw_headers
+
+    @defer.inlineCallbacks
+    def _request(
+        self,
+        method: str,
+        url: str,
+        *,
+        data=None,
+        headers=None,
+        verify_ssl=True,
+        proxies=None,
+    ):
+        body_producer = None
+        if data is not None:
+            if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
+                body = bytes(data)
+            else:
+                body = str(data).encode('utf-8')
+            body_producer = FileBodyProducer(BytesIO(body))
+
+        response = yield self._agent(verify_ssl, proxies).request(
+            method.encode('ascii'),
+            url.encode('utf-8'),
+            headers=self._build_headers(headers),
+            bodyProducer=body_producer,
+        )
+        content = yield treq.content(response)
+        defer.returnValue(_TreqResponse(response, content))
+
+    def _request_sync(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        _ensure_reactor_running()
+        return threads.blockingCallFromThread(reactor, self._request, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    def get(self, url, verify=True, proxies=None):
+        return self._request_sync('GET', url, verify_ssl=verify, proxies=proxies)
+
+    def post(self, url, data=None, headers=None, verify=True, proxies=None):
+        return self._request_sync(
+            'POST', url, data=data, headers=headers,
+            verify_ssl=verify, proxies=proxies,
+        )
+
+
